Name: Python
Description: General-purpose programming language and runtime interpreter.
Justification: Runs the entire backend server (FastAPI app, database layer, and ML jobs). Nothing on the server side runs without it.

Name: Node.js
Description: JavaScript runtime built on Chrome's V8 engine, including the npm package manager.
Justification: Needed only once at install time to compile the React web frontend into static files. Not required to run the server afterwards.

Name: npm
Description: Default package manager for Node.js; downloads and installs JavaScript packages.
Justification: Used during the build step to download the frontend's JavaScript/TypeScript dependencies and run 'npm run build'.

Name: PostgreSQL
Description: Open-source relational database server.
Justification: Production database storing users, documents, annotations (entities/relations), and ML job records. Optional - SQLite (bundled with Python) is used by default for single-machine/dev setups.

Name: pip
Description: Standard package installer for Python.
Justification: Installs all of the Python backend and ML libraries listed below from the Python Package Index (PyPI).

Name: fastapi
Description: Modern Python web framework for building REST APIs.
Justification: Implements the entire backend HTTP API (authentication, document/annotation endpoints, ML job triggers).

Name: uvicorn[standard]
Description: ASGI web server for running async Python web applications.
Justification: The actual server process that hosts the FastAPI app (start_server runs 'uvicorn app.main:app').

Name: sqlalchemy
Description: SQL toolkit and Object-Relational Mapper (ORM) for Python.
Justification: Defines the database models and runs all queries, working against either PostgreSQL or SQLite.

Name: psycopg2-binary
Description: PostgreSQL database adapter (driver) for Python.
Justification: Lets SQLAlchemy connect to PostgreSQL when a PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL is configured.

Name: pydantic
Description: Data validation and settings-management library using Python type hints.
Justification: Validates incoming API request/response payloads and loads typed application configuration.

Name: python-dotenv
Description: Reads key-value pairs from a .env file into environment variables.
Justification: Loads the backend/.env configuration file (database URL, secret key, model choices) at startup.

Name: PyJWT
Description: Library for encoding and decoding JSON Web Tokens (JWT).
Justification: Issues and verifies the JWT access tokens used to authenticate logged-in users.

Name: bcrypt
Description: Password-hashing library implementing the bcrypt algorithm.
Justification: Securely hashes and verifies user account passwords.

Name: python-multipart
Description: Streaming parser for multipart/form-data HTTP requests.
Justification: Required by FastAPI to handle form submissions and file/document uploads.

Name: spacy
Description: Industrial-strength Natural Language Processing (NLP) library.
Justification: Trains and runs the Named Entity Recognition (NER) models used by the Auto-Annotate feature. (Optional - only installed if ML features are enabled.)

Name: torch
Version: >=2.1 (optional CUDA build cu121 for NVIDIA GPUs)
Description: PyTorch - deep-learning framework for tensor computation and neural networks.
Justification: Backend engine for training the relation-extraction transformer model; auto-detects NVIDIA CUDA, Apple MPS, then CPU. (Optional ML dependency.)

Name: transformers
Description: Hugging Face library for pretrained transformer (BERT-family) models.
Justification: Loads and fine-tunes the DistilBERT/BERT model used for Relation Extraction (RE). (Optional ML dependency.)

Name: numpy
Description: Fundamental package for numerical array computing in Python.
Justification: Underpins the numerical/array operations used across the ML and embedding pipeline. (Optional ML dependency.)

Name: sentence-transformers
Description: Library producing dense sentence/text embeddings from BERT-family bi-encoders.
Justification: Generates sentence embeddings for the embedding-based relation rules (semantic similarity matching). (Optional ML dependency.)

Name: react
Description: JavaScript library for building user interfaces.
Justification: Core UI framework for the annotation web application. (Build-time; compiled into static files.)

Name: react-dom
Description: React package for rendering components to the web DOM.
Justification: Renders the React UI in the browser. (Build-time.)

Name: react-router-dom
Description: Client-side routing library for React.
Justification: Handles navigation between the application's pages/views without full page reloads. (Build-time.)

Name: typescript
Description: Typed superset of JavaScript that compiles to plain JavaScript.
Justification: Language the frontend source is written in; type-checks and compiles the code during build. (Build-time dev dependency.)

Name: vite
Description: Frontend build tool and development server.
Justification: Bundles the frontend into the optimized static files the server ships ('vite build'). (Build-time dev dependency.)

Name: @vitejs/plugin-react
Description: Official Vite plugin adding React (JSX/Fast Refresh) support.
Justification: Enables Vite to compile React/JSX code. (Build-time dev dependency.)

Name: @types/react
Description: TypeScript type definitions for React.
Justification: Provides type information so the TypeScript compiler understands React APIs. (Build-time dev dependency.)

Name: @types/react-dom
Description: TypeScript type definitions for React DOM.
Justification: Provides type information for react-dom APIs during compilation. (Build-time dev dependency.)

Name: distilbert-base-uncased
Description: Pretrained DistilBERT language model (~265 MB).
Justification: Fine-tuned in-app to perform Relation Extraction between annotated entities. Downloaded automatically from the Hugging Face Hub when the relation-extraction trainer first runs. (Optional - ML features only.)

Name: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
Description: Pretrained MiniLM sentence-embedding model (~90 MB).
Justification: Produces the sentence embeddings used by embedding-based relation rules. Downloaded automatically from the Hugging Face Hub on first use. (Optional - ML features only.)
